title: AC1027 MLINE LTYPE XDATA reference to a source-bound INSERT target

scope.source: Runtime-generated ASCII and binary DXF records; no repository DWG/DXF fixture was added.
scope.route: One source-bound code-1005 XDATA soft pointer in the EditDash LTYPE to a simple INSERT in model-space ENTITIES.
scope.encoding_matrix: ASCII and binary source crossed with ASCII and binary output.
scope.runtime_fixture: The focused test authors the DXF source in a temporary directory and removes it; no test drawing was committed.

sources.title: INSERT (DXF)
sources.relevant_rule: Defines INSERT block name, insertion point, scale, rotation, array counts and spacing.

sources.title: Persistent Inter-Object Reference Handles (DXF)
sources.relevant_rule: XDATA group 1005 is a soft-pointer handle and is translated when referenced objects are copied or inserted.

sources.title: Nested BLOCK name and canonical MINSERT profile research
sources.relevant_rule: Keeps block-name references in the BLOCK_RECORD name namespace and distinguishes simple INSERT from array and unsupported derived profiles.

proof.source: The collector matches the physical INSERT group-2 name with the typed INSERT, validates the unique live entity and owner, and resolves the name to a uniquely captured BLOCK_RECORD plus matched BLOCK/ENDBLK source membership. It admits only a simple one-by-one INSERT without attributes or SEQEND.
proof.output: The finalizer checks the remapped INSERT identity and owner, emitted BLOCK_RECORD identity/owner, and source-to-output BLOCK and ENDBLK identities with the same emitted owner. The runtime test verifies the physical remapped XDATA handle, INSERT fields, BLOCK_RECORD name, BLOCK/ENDBLK membership and ownership, and fresh typed readback.
proof.failure_retry: For each of four input/output encoding pairs, removing the referenced INSERT target refuses export while preserving the destination; restoring the target succeeds on the same adapter. A separate ASCII case mutates the INSERT name after provider emission, verifies refusal and destination preservation, then restores the name and retries successfully.

implementation.source_binding: Adds INSERT record/callback recognition and type admission to the existing LTYPE XDATA target collector, captures its referenced BLOCK_RECORD identity, and revalidates the source graph before publication.
implementation.output_identity: Uses the writer's actual emitted-record inventory and source-entity bindings for BLOCK and ENDBLK; resolves the BLOCK_RECORD output by its source-bound name and verifies its physical TABLES identity and owner.
implementation.consumer_compatibility: Changes only converter-private dx_iface state and callbacks; no public DRW_Interface virtual or installed model layout changed.
implementation.claim_boundary: This is one selected AC1027 transport/source-identity/output/readback profile. It does not establish general INSERT, MINSERT, attribute, nested graph, native application or full-document support.

focused_ctest.result: PASS (1/1, 17.98 seconds); the test asserts the aggregate profile, readback, refusal and retry counts above.

validation.asan: NOT_RUN; no parser ownership or persistent state was added. Revisit at the planned sanitizer checkpoint.

limits: Only one AC1027 simple INSERT profile in model-space ENTITIES is qualified. INSERT targets in named BLOCKS, MINSERT arrays, attributes, SEQEND, other INSERT fields, target sets and versions remain open.
This evidence does not establish INSERT placement semantics, referenced-block recursive closure, native CAD acceptance or support-claim eligibility.
